title: The Tunnel
subject: English
summary: “The Tunnel” is an interesting story about a young boy named Ranji who loves exploring nature. One day, he discovers a railway tunnel and becomes curious about it. He meets an old watchman named Suraj, who is responsible for keeping the tunnel safe. Ranji learns about the tunnel, trains and the dangers of railway tracks. Through his experiences, he becomes more aware of the importance of courage, carefulness and responsibility. The story teaches us that adventure is exciting, but we should always be careful and responsible while exploring new places.
